sql_gold: SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '清华大学出版社' GROUP BY c.category_name

question_zh: 查询赵敏老师借过的图书书名和借阅日期
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, br.borrow_date FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.name = '赵敏'

question_zh: 列出二楼文学借阅区的中国文学类图书书名和作者
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, b.author FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.floor = 2 AND c.category_name = '中国文学'

question_zh: 统计每个出版社2025年出版的图书数量
sql_gold: SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE b.publish_year = 2025 GROUP BY p.publisher_name

question_zh: 查询计算机学院读者未归还的图书书名和读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT r.name, b.title FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.department = '计算机学院' AND br.return_date IS NULL

question_zh: 列出电子工业出版社出版的人工智能类图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '电子工业出版社' AND c.category_name = '人工智能'

question_zh: 统计2025年每个月的不同分类借阅量
sql_gold: SELECT substr(br.borrow_date,1,7) AS month, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE br.borrow_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month, c.category_name

question_zh: 查询经济学院读者借过的经济学类图书书名，去重
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT b.title FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.department = '经济学院' AND c.category_name = '经济学'

question_zh: 列出四楼社科借阅区的管理学类可借图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.floor = 4 AND c.category_name = '管理学' AND b.available_copies > 0

question_zh: 统计人民文学出版社出版的文学类图书总数量
sql_gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '人民文学出版社' AND c.category_name IN ('中国文学', '外国文学')

question_zh: 查询续借过2次的读者姓名和对应的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT r.name, b.title FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE br.renew_count = 2

question_zh: 列出外研社出版的英语语言类图书书名和出版年份
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, b.publish_year FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '外语教学与研究出版社' AND c.category_name = '英语语言'

question_zh: 统计每个读者类型的图书借阅总数量
sql_gold: SELECT r.reader_type, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_type

question_zh: 查询2025年5月借出的数学类图书书名和借阅日期
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, br.borrow_date FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '数学' AND br.borrow_date LIKE '2025-05%'

question_zh: 列出借阅量最高的5本图书的书名和被借次数
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM books b JOIN borrow_records br ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT 5

question_zh: 王晓明今年（2025年）都借了些什么书？
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT b.title FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.name = '王晓明' AND br.borrow_date LIKE '2025%'

question_zh: 统计每个馆藏地2025年的借阅量
sql_gold: SELECT l.location_name, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE br.borrow_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY l.location_name

question_zh: 列出2020年及以后出版的可借计算机类图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '计算机科学' AND b.publish_year >= 2020 AND b.available_copies > 0

question_zh: 查询外国语学院读者借过的英语类图书书名，去重
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT b.title FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.department = '外国语学院' AND c.category_name = '英语语言'

question_zh: 统计每个分类的平均图书复本数
sql_gold: SELECT c.category_name, AVG(b.total_copies) AS avg_copies FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_name

question_zh: 《数据库系统概念》这本书之前都是谁借的、什么时候还回来的？只看已经归还的
sql_gold: SELECT r.name, br.return_date FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.title = '数据库系统概念' AND br.return_date IS NOT NULL

question_zh: 列出三楼理科区2025年出版的可借图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.floor = 3 AND b.publish_year = 2025 AND b.available_copies > 0

question_zh: 统计每个出版社的图书总可借数量
sql_gold: SELECT p.publisher_name, SUM(b.available_copies) AS total_available FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id GROUP BY p.publisher_name

question_zh: 查询研究生读者未归还的图书书名和应还日期
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, br.due_date FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE r.reader_type = '研究生' AND br.return_date IS NULL

question_zh: 列出作者是斋藤康毅的图书所在的馆藏地名称
sql_gold: SELECT l.location_name FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE b.author = '斋藤康毅'

question_zh: 找出借阅量超过其所在学院平均借阅量的读者姓名和借阅次数
sql_gold: WITH rc AS (SELECT r.reader_id, r.name, r.department, COUNT(br.record_id) AS cnt FROM readers r LEFT JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name, r.department), da AS (SELECT department, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM rc GROUP BY department) SELECT rc.name, rc.cnt FROM rc JOIN da ON rc.department = da.department WHERE rc.cnt > da.avg_cnt

question_zh: 有没有从来没人借过的书？列一下书名
sql_gold: SELECT title FROM books WHERE book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records)

question_zh: 找出借阅总量最高的学院名称及其借阅量
sql_gold: SELECT r.department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.department ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

question_zh: 查询借阅过至少4本不同图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT br.book_id) >= 4

question_zh: 找出出版图书数量高于各出版社平均出版量的出版社名称
sql_gold: WITH pc AS (SELECT p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name, COUNT(b.book_id) AS cnt FROM publishers p LEFT JOIN books b ON p.publisher_id = b.publisher_id GROUP BY p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name) SELECT publisher_name FROM pc WHERE cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM pc)

question_zh: 以2025年7月1日为参照，查询所有逾期未还的借阅：列出读者姓名、书名和应还日期
sql_gold: SELECT r.name, b.title, br.due_date FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE br.return_date IS NULL AND br.due_date < '2025-07-01'

question_zh: 统计2025年每个月的借阅量
sql_gold: SELECT substr(borrow_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records WHERE borrow_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY substr(borrow_date, 1, 7)

question_zh: 既借过计算机科学类又借过中国文学类图书的读者都有谁？
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '计算机科学') AND reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '中国文学')

question_zh: 找出每个学院借阅量最高的读者姓名及其借阅次数
sql_gold: WITH rc AS (SELECT r.reader_id, r.name, r.department, COUNT(br.record_id) AS cnt FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name, r.department) SELECT department, name, cnt FROM rc WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM rc rc2 WHERE rc2.department = rc.department)

question_zh: 查询可借复本占馆藏复本比例低于30%的图书书名和该比例
sql_gold: SELECT title, available_copies * 1.0 / total_copies AS ratio FROM books WHERE available_copies * 1.0 / total_copies < 0.3

question_zh: 查询从来没有借过数学类图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '数学')

question_zh: 找出2024年出版但从来没被借过的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT title FROM books WHERE publish_year = 2024 AND book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records)

question_zh: 哪些读者的借阅量比全馆平均水平还高？姓名和借了多少次都要
sql_gold: WITH reader_borrow AS (SELECT reader_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records GROUP BY reader_id) SELECT r.name, rb.cnt FROM readers r JOIN reader_borrow rb ON r.reader_id = rb.reader_id WHERE rb.cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM reader_borrow)

question_zh: 找出每个出版社出版的最新图书书名和出版年份
sql_gold: WITH pub_max AS (SELECT publisher_id, MAX(publish_year) AS max_year FROM books GROUP BY publisher_id) SELECT p.publisher_name, b.title, b.publish_year FROM books b JOIN pub_max pm ON b.publisher_id = pm.publisher_id AND b.publish_year = pm.max_year JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id

question_zh: 查询同时借过计算机类和数学类图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '计算机科学') AND reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '数学')

question_zh: 以2025年7月1日为参照，找出逾期超过30天的读者姓名、图书书名和逾期天数
sql_gold: SELECT r.name, b.title, CAST(julianday('2025-07-01') - julianday(br.due_date) AS INTEGER) AS overdue_days FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE br.return_date IS NULL AND br.due_date < date('2025-07-01', '-30 days')

question_zh: 找出每个分类下借阅量最高的图书书名和借阅次数
sql_gold: WITH cat_borrow AS (SELECT b.category_id, b.book_id, b.title, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.category_id, b.book_id, b.title) SELECT c.category_name, cb.title, cb.cnt FROM cat_borrow cb JOIN categories c ON cb.category_id = c.category_id WHERE cb.cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM cat_borrow cb2 WHERE cb2.category_id = cb.category_id)

question_zh: 查询可借复本占总复本比例超过70%的图书书名和比例
sql_gold: SELECT title, ROUND(available_copies * 1.0 / total_copies, 2) AS ratio FROM books WHERE available_copies * 1.0 / total_copies > 0.7

question_zh: 找出每个学院借阅量最高的读者姓名和借阅次数
sql_gold: WITH dept_borrow AS (SELECT r.department, r.reader_id, r.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.department, r.reader_id, r.name) SELECT department, name, cnt FROM dept_borrow db WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM dept_borrow db2 WHERE db2.department = db.department)

question_zh: 查询既借过2024年出版的书又借过2025年出版的书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.publish_year = 2024 AND r.reader_id IN (SELECT br2.reader_id FROM borrow_records br2 JOIN books b2 ON br2.book_id = b2.book_id WHERE b2.publish_year = 2025)

question_zh: 找出从来没有被借过的2020年及以后出版的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT title FROM books WHERE publish_year >= 2020 AND book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records)

question_zh: 查询图书数量高于全馆出版社平均出书量的出版社名称
sql_gold: WITH pub_count AS (SELECT publisher_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books GROUP BY publisher_id) SELECT p.publisher_name FROM pub_count pc JOIN publishers p ON pc.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE pc.cnt > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM pub_count)

question_zh: 找出每个楼层最古老（出版年份最早）的图书书名和年份
sql_gold: WITH floor_min AS (SELECT l.floor, MIN(b.publish_year) AS min_year FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.floor) SELECT l.floor, b.title, b.publish_year FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id JOIN floor_min fm ON l.floor = fm.floor AND b.publish_year = fm.min_year

question_zh: 查询续借过至少2次不同图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id WHERE br.renew_count >= 2 GROUP BY r.reader_id, r.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT br.book_id) >= 2

question_zh: 找出所有在馆可借但从来没被借过的图书书名和所在馆藏地
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, l.location_name FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE b.available_copies = b.total_copies AND b.book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records)

question_zh: 统计每个分类中2025年新出版图书占该分类总图书的比例
sql_gold: WITH cat_total AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM books GROUP BY category_id), cat_2025 AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books WHERE publish_year = 2025 GROUP BY category_id) SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(COALESCE(c25.cnt,0) * 1.0 / ct.total, 2) AS ratio FROM cat_total ct JOIN categories c ON ct.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN cat_2025 c25 ON ct.category_id = c25.category_id

question_zh: 哪些读者借的书全都还清了、手里没有未归还的？列出姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL)

question_zh: 找出每个读者类型中借阅量最高的读者姓名和借阅次数
sql_gold: WITH type_borrow AS (SELECT r.reader_type, r.reader_id, r.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id GROUP BY r.reader_type, r.reader_id, r.name) SELECT reader_type, name, cnt FROM type_borrow tb WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM type_borrow tb2 WHERE tb2.reader_type = tb.reader_type)

question_zh: 查询被至少3个不同学院读者借过的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.department) >= 3

question_zh: 找出2025年每个月借阅量最高的图书分类
sql_gold: WITH month_cat AS (SELECT substr(br.borrow_date,1,7) AS month, c.category_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE br.borrow_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month, c.category_name) SELECT month, category_name, cnt FROM month_cat mc WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM month_cat mc2 WHERE mc2.month = mc.month)

question_zh: 查询总借阅量低于全馆图书平均借阅量的图书书名
sql_gold: WITH book_borrow AS (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records GROUP BY book_id) SELECT b.title FROM books b LEFT JOIN book_borrow bb ON b.book_id = bb.book_id WHERE COALESCE(bb.cnt,0) < (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM book_borrow)

question_zh: 找出每个馆藏地可借数量最多的图书书名
sql_gold: WITH loc_available AS (SELECT l.location_id, l.location_name, b.book_id, b.title, b.available_copies FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id) SELECT location_name, title, available_copies FROM loc_available la WHERE available_copies = (SELECT MAX(available_copies) FROM loc_available la2 WHERE la2.location_id = la.location_id)

question_zh: 查询同时借过文学类和经济类图书的教师读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_type = '教师' AND reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name IN ('中国文学','外国文学')) AND reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '经济学')

question_zh: 计算2025年每个学院读者的人均借阅量（借阅总量/学院读者人数）
sql_gold: WITH dept_borrow AS (SELECT r.department, COUNT(*) AS borrow_cnt FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id WHERE br.borrow_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY r.department), dept_readers AS (SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS reader_cnt FROM readers GROUP BY department) SELECT dr.department, ROUND(COALESCE(db.borrow_cnt,0) * 1.0 / dr.reader_cnt, 2) AS avg_borrow FROM dept_readers dr LEFT JOIN dept_borrow db ON dr.department = db.department

question_zh: 以2025年7月1日为参照，找出所有逾期未还的图书中，出版年份最早的图书书名和出版年份
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, b.publish_year FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id WHERE br.return_date IS NULL AND br.due_date < '2025-07-01' ORDER BY b.publish_year ASC LIMIT 1

question_zh: 查询从来没有被研究生借过的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT title FROM books WHERE book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT br.book_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id WHERE r.reader_type = '研究生')

question_zh: 找出每个出版社可借比例最高的图书书名
sql_gold: WITH pub_ratio AS (SELECT p.publisher_id, p.publisher_name, b.book_id, b.title, b.available_copies * 1.0 / b.total_copies AS ratio FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id) SELECT publisher_name, title, ROUND(ratio,2) AS ratio FROM pub_ratio pr WHERE ratio = (SELECT MAX(ratio) FROM pub_ratio pr2 WHERE pr2.publisher_id = pr.publisher_id)

question_zh: 2024年注册的新读者里，哪些人已经借过书了？列姓名
sql_gold: SELECT r.name FROM readers r WHERE r.register_date LIKE '2024%' AND r.reader_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records)

question_zh: 统计每个分类图书的零借阅率（从来没被借过的图书/分类总图书数）
sql_gold: WITH cat_total AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS total FROM books GROUP BY category_id), cat_unborrowed AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books WHERE book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records) GROUP BY category_id) SELECT c.category_name, ROUND(COALESCE(cu.cnt,0) * 1.0 / ct.total, 2) AS zero_borrow_ratio FROM cat_total ct JOIN categories c ON ct.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN cat_unborrowed cu ON ct.category_id = cu.category_id

question_zh: 找出既借过中国文学类图书又借过外国文学类图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '中国文学') AND reader_id IN (SELECT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '外国文学')

question_zh: 查询总复本数高于所在分类平均复本数的图书书名
sql_gold: WITH cat_avg AS (SELECT category_id, AVG(total_copies) AS avg_copies FROM books GROUP BY category_id) SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN cat_avg ca ON b.category_id = ca.category_id WHERE b.total_copies > ca.avg_copies

question_zh: 找出每个月借阅量最高的读者姓名
sql_gold: WITH month_reader AS (SELECT substr(br.borrow_date,1,7) AS month, r.reader_id, r.name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id GROUP BY month, r.reader_id, r.name) SELECT month, name, cnt FROM month_reader mr WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM month_reader mr2 WHERE mr2.month = mr.month)

question_zh: 查询2025年出版的图书中，可借数量为0的图书占2025年图书总数的比例
sql_gold: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN available_copies = 0 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS ratio FROM books WHERE publish_year = 2025

question_zh: 找出从来没有借过外文类图书的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '英语语言')

question_zh: 查询每个分类中，出版年份最新的3本图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT c.category_name, b.title, b.publish_year FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books b2 WHERE b2.category_id = b.category_id AND b2.publish_year > b.publish_year) < 3 ORDER BY c.category_name, b.publish_year DESC

question_zh: 计算所有读者的平均未归还图书数量
sql_gold: WITH reader_unreturned AS (SELECT reader_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL GROUP BY reader_id) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_unreturned FROM reader_unreturned

question_zh: 找出机械工业出版社出版的图书中，借阅量最高的图书书名
sql_gold: SELECT b.title, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN borrow_records br ON b.book_id = br.book_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '机械工业出版社' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT 1

question_zh: 查询至少续借过1次且所有图书都已归还的读者姓名
sql_gold: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id WHERE br.renew_count > 0 AND r.reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL)

question_zh: 统计每个楼层的图书零借阅率
sql_gold: WITH loc_total AS (SELECT l.location_id, l.floor, COUNT(*) AS total FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.location_id, l.floor), loc_unborrowed AS (SELECT l.location_id, l.floor, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE b.book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records) GROUP BY l.location_id, l.floor) SELECT lt.floor, ROUND(COALESCE(lu.cnt,0)*1.0/lt.total,2) AS zero_borrow_ratio FROM loc_total lt LEFT JOIN loc_unborrowed lu ON lt.location_id = lu.location_id

question_zh: 王晓明还没借过的计算机类图书有哪些？想给他推荐几本
sql_gold: SELECT b.title FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '计算机科学' AND b.book_id NOT IN (SELECT br.book_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN readers r ON br.reader_id = r.reader_id WHERE r.name = '王晓明')
